verdict.rationale: Capacities documents full-space export with automated scheduling, and exports properties as front matter/CSV that are explicitly described as 'fully human- and machine-readable,' enabling reuse in other apps. This directly supports switcher-style exit/import flows (also evidenced by the Notion migration guide reversed). missing for 10: no independent/hands-on verification of export completeness (e.g., all object types, media, block links) and no confirmation of long-term format stability.
